aspect: The question is what she did
description: What she wore, why she was there, why she went to his office, why she did not report it immediately. The inquiry reorients onto the complainant automatically.
energy_note: An investigation that turns around to face her.

description: If reporting costs the degree, the job and the reputation and produces no sanction, silence is the correct strategy - and every dataset built on reports therefore undercounts.
energy_note: A number nobody has, for reasons that are themselves the harm.

aspect: And the low numbers are then used as evidence
description: Few formal complaints is read as few incidents, which is used to argue against the legislation that would make complaining survivable.
energy_note: Silence, counted as absence, and cited as proof.

description: She tells two colleagues. Within a week it is known, and the version circulating has her at fault in a way the original did not. She stops mentioning it, which is recorded by everyone as the matter being resolved.
energy_note: Telling two people, and watching it change shape.
